title: Explicit bundled endpoints and universal finite realization calculation
statement: For categories B and C, a family classes:I -> Hom(X,Y) and a compatibility predicate on pairs of arrows and indices, FiniteRouteData stores a functor B -> C, its supported source isomorphism and its target map, with a universal realization identity for compatible pairs. For an arbitrary finite realization eW, ordinary supported and line comparisons, an internal derived functor F and endpoints a,t, finiteRouteData specializes this record to exact finite realization. Its proved realize field states: for every beta and alpha with F(beta) followed by t = a.hom followed by alpha, the stored supported map followed by finiteRealizedClass(alpha).hom equals the stored functor applied to beta followed by the stored line map. finiteRouteData constructs those data by exact realization and proves the universal field by finiteRealization_composition. No data depends on an existence theorem or on the arrow supplied later.

proof.text: Construct the realized functor and both endpoints explicitly. For arbitrary beta, alpha and their supplied compatibility equation, use the proved finiteRealization_composition. Keeping these fields together makes their shared types available without expanding the large functors. The explicit class family finiteRealizedArrowMap and the input predicate routeArrowCompatible are named functions, retaining the native endpoint expressions behind their definitions.
